spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Propagation of Spiritual Death Through the Realm of Falsity

---

**¶1:** Did the state of spiritual death arise and establish itself as a ruling principle [GAP-1: perhaps: over all the faculties] from below? Or did it turn itself away from [GAP-2: perhaps: the divine order toward] its external falsities serving as defense [GAP-3] within its own [GAP-4: perhaps: domain], yet it brought to completion [GAP-5: perhaps: its organization into] the two [GAP-6: perhaps: fundamental divisions of perverted will and corrupted understanding].

---

**¶2:** [GAP-7: perhaps: This ruling falsity] set it into motion and [GAP-8: perhaps: stirred up] those who dwell in the [GAP-9: perhaps: deepest ground] of the foundation of the realm of falsity from evil [GAP-10: perhaps: and this was the] first stage of its propagation.

---

**¶3:** Yet after a prolonged state, when there was no [GAP-11: perhaps: containment or resistance], the infernal influx surged and welled upward [GAP-12: perhaps: through all the levels] — the five genera of falsity from evil that surged forth [GAP-13: perhaps: from the depths] — which are: dense falsity obscuring all perception, self-love consuming from within, destructive persuasions of the reasoning faculty, falsity imitating truth, and utter spiritual blindness [GAP-14: perhaps: and these arose] the second time [GAP-15: perhaps: with greater force, and] they were organized into fixed and hardened forms [GAP-16: perhaps: becoming the very structures] in which spiritual death was permanently established [GAP-17: perhaps: as a governing principle].

---

**¶4:** The fourth stage of propagation is the evil works [GAP-18: perhaps: that were brought forth and ripened] within the five perceptions rooted in evil that exist in the five provinces of the infernal realm.

---

**¶5:** At the fifth stage, spiritual death extended itself into all derivative affections and thoughts that exist throughout the five provinces of hell — those that were shaped and generated from the five kinds of evil works produced by spiritual death. These are the five states of the selfhood, the five genera of infernal life in which spiritual death has established its dominion. It extended itself into ten aspects: five belonging to the perverted understanding and five belonging to the corrupted will [GAP-19: perhaps: thus filling both faculties entirely].

---

**¶6:** Now, just as the entire realm of falsity from evil sustains itself, in that its animating life-principle and its [GAP-20: perhaps: ruling love] nourished the five genera of falsity [GAP-21: perhaps: from their very origin]; so also [GAP-22: REVIEW how] the ten aspects residing in the perverted understanding and the corrupted will — the self-love and concupiscence of the selfhood [GAP-23: perhaps: inflamed and drove] them, as they forcibly conjoined them with one another [GAP-24: perhaps: into a single infernal will], and they were marshaled in opposition against the Divine Celestial Human. This is [GAP-25: perhaps: the final state] of the realm of falsity from evil: it was condemned to perpetual separation from the Divine.

---

**¶7:** Corresponding to the mystery of these twelve complete aspects of falsity that arose within the realm of spiritual darkness [GAP-26: perhaps: and were arrayed] against the Divine Celestial Human — the twelve [GAP-27: perhaps: genera of falsity correspond to] the twelve spirits of error that came into being as perversions of the twelve universal states of divine order through which all spiritual influx descends [GAP-28: perhaps: and which, being inverted, became the complete circle of falsification].

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Did Death arise and stand firm [from below] up? Or else did it turn itself from [the Light to] its armour [that is] in its [land] but it finished [and became] the two [parts].
[And] it moved it and [aroused] they that are in the [depths] of the earth of Darkness [this is the] first part.

Yet, after a long time, as there was not [rest], it gushed and streamed up [...] the five elements of Death that gushed [forth] which are smoke, fire, wind, water and Darkness [and this is] the second time [that] they were sculpted [into] those in which Death was established [in them].
The fourth part is the evil fruits [that grew] in the five trees that are in the five worlds of the land of Darkness.

The fifth time it spread itself out to its creatures that exist in the five worlds; the ones that were formed and generated from the five fruits of Death. They are the five worlds of flesh, the five creations of Darkness in which Death has been established. It spread itself out to ten parts, five male parts and five female [parts].

Now, like the land of Darkness, in that its spirit and its [soul] they nourished the five elements [from the beginning]; this is also [how] the ten parts that are in male and female, the Fire and Lust of the flesh [burned in] them, as they yoke them with one another [and] they were established against the First Man. This is [the end] of the Darkness, it was condemned for ever.

Alongside the mystery of these twelve parts that came about in the Darkness [and rose up] against the First Man. The twelve [parts are] the twelve spirits of error that came about from the twelve signs of the zodiac [...].

fills.explanation: Death rising "from below up" describes the infernal principle surging upward from the lowest depths, matching the spiritual sense of spiritual death establishing itself as a ruling principle from beneath.

The spiritual reading specifies "from the divine order toward" — in Manichaean register, "the Light" is the standard term for the divine order, so Death "turned itself from the Light to its armour" means it reoriented away from the Light boundary toward its own defenses in the land of Darkness.
A standard Coptic relative clause connector locating Death's armour within its own territory — "its armour that is in its land" — matching the spiritual reading's "defense within its own domain."

The Kephalaia consistently uses "land" (of Darkness, of Light) for domain/realm, and the spiritual reading indicates "domain" — "in its land" is the standard Manichaean register for the infernal territory.

The spiritual reading says Death "brought to completion its organization into" the two divisions — "it finished and became the two parts" captures Death completing its process and assuming its dual form.

The chapter repeatedly uses "parts" as its term for divisions of Death's propagation, and the spiritual reading describes "two fundamental divisions" — "the two parts" is the natural Kephalaia expression.
The most common Kephalaia paragraph-opening connector, transitioning from the questions in ¶1 to the description of Death's first action in ¶2.
Parallel to "moved" — Death moved the realm and aroused those dwelling in the depths, matching the spiritual reading's "stirred up" in Kephalaia register.
The spiritual reading says "deepest ground" and the Kephalaia naturally describes the lowest region of the infernal earth as its "depths" — those dwelling in the depths of the earth of Darkness.
Introduces the stage-identification formula consistent with the chapter's enumeration pattern — "this is the first part" mirrors the later "the second time," "the fourth part," "the fifth time."
In Manichaean cosmology, "rest" (anapausis) is the key term for the state of equilibrium before disturbance — when there was no rest, the elements erupted and gushed upward.
Completes the standard Kephalaia expression "gushed forth" — the five elements of Death gushed forth from the depths of Darkness.
Mirrors the identification formula used for the first part (GAP-10) — "and this is the second time" continues the enumeration of Death's stages of propagation.
Relative conjunction connecting the second stage to its description — "the second time that they were sculpted" identifies what occurred at the second stage.
Sculpting requires a resultative preposition — "they were sculpted into those in which Death was established" describes the five elements being shaped into fixed forms.
Standard Coptic resumptive pronoun completing the relative clause — "those in which Death was established in them" is normal Coptic syntax where the pronoun resumes the relative.
The natural metaphor for fruits within trees — "evil fruits that grew in the five trees" matches the spiritual reading's "brought forth and ripened" in the Kephalaia's botanical imagery.
Direct parallel with "five male parts" earlier in the same sentence requires "five female parts" to complete the symmetrical division into ten.

The pairing "spirit and soul" (pneuma and psyche) is the standard Manichaean dyad for the animating life-principle and its ruling love — the spiritual reading confirms "ruling love" which corresponds to "soul" in Kephalaia vocabulary.
The spiritual reading indicates "from their very origin" — "nourished the five elements from the beginning" establishes that the spirit and soul of Darkness sustained its elements from the outset.

Confirming the editor's choice: "this is also how" correctly renders the analogical connector linking the Darkness nourishing its elements to the manner in which Fire and Lust drive the ten parts, matching the spiritual sense of "so also."
The Fire and Lust of the flesh "burned in them" — the infernal fire burning within the ten parts drives the yoking described in the next clause, matching the spiritual reading's "inflamed."
Simple coordinating connector linking the yoking action to its consequence — "yoke them with one another and they were established against the First Man."

The spiritual reading indicates "the final state" — "This is the end of the Darkness, it was condemned for ever" states the ultimate fate, with "the end" matching the Kephalaia's eschatological vocabulary.

The twelve parts came about in the Darkness "and rose up" against the First Man — this hostile uprising is the standard Kephalaia expression for Darkness's aggression against the divine, matching "were arrayed" in the spiritual reading.

Standard Kephalaia identification formula — "The twelve parts are the twelve spirits of error" directly equates the twelve divisions of Darkness with the twelve spirits, continuing the expository pattern.
